billing_faq_1_question: How do I download my invoice?
billing_faq_1_answer: You can download your invoice from the billing section in your account dashboard. Navigate to 'Billing' > 'Invoices' and click the download button next to the invoice you need.
billing_faq_2_question: What payment methods do you accept?
billing_faq_2_answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, and bank transfers. Payment is processed securely through our encrypted payment gateway.
billing_faq_3_question: How can I update my billing information?
billing_faq_3_answer: To update your billing information, go to your account settings and select 'Billing Information'. You can update your payment method, billing address, and contact details there.
billing_faq_4_question: What should I do if I have a billing dispute?
billing_faq_4_answer: If you have a billing dispute, please contact our support team with your invoice number and details of the issue. We'll investigate and resolve the matter within 5-7 business days.
technical_faq_1_question: How do I reset my password?
technical_faq_1_answer: To reset your password, click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email address, and follow the instructions in the email we send you.
technical_faq_2_question: Why is the application running slowly?
technical_faq_2_answer: Slow performance can be caused by several factors including internet connection, browser cache, or server load. Try clearing your browser cache, checking your internet connection, or contact support if the issue persists.
technical_faq_3_question: How do I report a bug or technical issue?
technical_faq_3_answer: You can report bugs through our support system or use the 'Report Issue' button in the application. Please include detailed steps to reproduce the issue and any error messages you see.
technical_faq_4_answer: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. For the best experience, we recommend using Chrome or Firefox with JavaScript enabled.
general_faq_1_question: How do I get started with the platform?
general_faq_1_answer: After creating your account, you can access our Getting Started guide in the Help section. It provides step-by-step instructions for setting up your profile and using the main features.
general_faq_2_question: Can I invite team members to my account?
general_faq_2_answer: Yes, you can invite team members through the 'Team Management' section in your account settings. You can set different permission levels and manage access for each team member.
general_faq_3_question: How do I contact customer support?
general_faq_3_answer: You can contact our support team through this chat, email us at support@euldtparticipate.eu, or use the support form in your account dashboard. We aim to respond within 24 hours.
general_faq_4_question: Is my data secure and private?
general_faq_4_answer: Yes, we take data security seriously. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, we comply with GDPR regulations, and we never share your personal information with third parties without your consent.
